Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondent no.4 and Sri Vaibhav Tripathi, learned counsel for respondents no.1, 2 and 3.
2.

The instant petition has been filed praying for quashing of the orders dated 08.05.2023 and 16.11.2021 passed by respondent no.3, i.e. Deputy Chief Planning Manager, Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited, District Meerut rejecting the claim of the petitioner for grant of benefits under the Second Schedule to the Right to Fair Compensation in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Ankit Vikal vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115782302/
1 3.

entities.text: Deputy Chief Planning Manager, Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited, District Meerut
entities.label: RESPONDENT

entities.text: Ankit Vikal vs Union Of India And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The claim has been rejected on the ground that as per the Entitlement Matrix for DFC Project in accordance with the new Act, the cut off date for identifying the affected families including the land owners, those having title claims recognized under other State and Central laws, and squatters shall be the date of first land acquisition notification issued under Section 20-A of the Railway Amendment Act of 2008 for the Project for which Resettlement Action plan is proposed to be prepared.

4. Concededly, the notification under Section 20-A of the Railways Act was issued on 25.03.2015 and the petitioner had purchased the property on 05.05.2015 that is after the issuance of the initial notification under Section 20-A of the Railways Act.
5. Therefore, we find no merit in the instant petition.

Order Date :- 16.4.2024 AKShukla/-
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
